clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Comments On Internal Security And Ideologies
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi accused ideological supporters of Naxalism of infiltrating political and social organizations.
The Prime Minister observed 'Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas' in memory of Birsa Munda and stated tribal communities suffered under previous administrations.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Very Poor To Severe Categories
aiSummaryBullets: Most monitoring stations in Delhi continue to record air quality levels classified as very poor or severe.
Specific locations including IIT-Delhi have reported air quality index readings exceeding 400.

clusters.headline: India Under-19 Asia Cup Victory Followed By On-Field Controversy
aiSummaryBullets: India's Under-19 team achieved a victory in the Asia Cup tournament.
Player Lakshya Raichandani credited Aaryavir Sehwag for his critical batting performance during the team's successful run chase.

clusters.headline: Diljit Dosanjh Performs In Indore Amidst Threats Of Concert Cancellation
aiSummaryBullets: Punjabi artist Diljit Dosanjh proceeded with his Indore concert despite facing opposition and threats to his performance.
Authorities investigated email warnings regarding potential bomb threats at the venue and determined them to be hoaxes.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Sparks Political Debate And Personal Revelations
aiSummaryBullets: The memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love provides insights into historical political moments, including the 1969 Presidential elections and the 1999 Congress revolt.
Personal anecdotes in the book range from Sonia Gandhi's 1978 visit to Indira Gandhi in Tihar Jail to her reflections on interactions with Pranab Mukherjee.

clusters.headline: Prince William And Kate Middleton To Attend Earthshot Prize In Mumbai
aiSummaryBullets: Prince William and Kate Middleton are traveling to Mumbai for the sixth annual Earthshot Prize ceremony.
The event, scheduled from November 16 to 18, 2026, focuses on environmental innovation and global challenges.

clusters.headline: Twenty Four People Die Following Bus Collision In Assam India
aiSummaryBullets: At least 24 individuals were killed after a minibus and a trailer truck collided in the Indian state of Assam.
Casualties include several children, college students, and the bus driver, according to government officials.

clusters.headline: India And United States Reach Agreement On Preferential Market Access
aiSummaryBullets: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India and the U.S. have finalized an agreement regarding preferential market access for Indian exports.
The agreement experienced delays due to shifting tariff conditions in the United States necessitating further rounds of negotiations.

clusters.headline: Suspect Killed In Police Shootout In West Bengal's Santiniketan
aiSummaryBullets: A history-sheeter identified as Ratan Sheikh was killed in a shootout with police while attempting to evade arrest.
The individual had reportedly opened fire on a constable, leaving the officer injured during the initial apprehension effort.

clusters.headline: Devotees Access Palghar Lake Despite Official Chhath Puja Bans
aiSummaryBullets: Officials in Palghar prohibited Chhath Puja rituals at Nagela lake.
The main entrance to the site was locked to prevent unauthorized access.
